label: Claude Code Session
description: A single Claude Code session at full fidelity: the terminal window with the Claude Code banner, user prompts, tool-call blocks (Read/Bash/Update with results and green/red diffs), the working spinner with live elapsed-seconds and climbing token counter, todo checklists, and streaming responses. SCRIPTED: pass the whole coding story in data.script -- the component performs it itself; embedding it static and animating over it is wrong. CAMERA ANCHORS: publishes data-anchor regions (input, transcript) -- target them from scene camera_moves as {anchor: 'componentId.anchorName'}; the ONE stage camera does all zooming.

title.label: Window title (default 'claude — ~/project'; cwd builds it too)

cwd.label: Working directory shown in the title and banner (e.g. '~/acme-api')

model_label.label: Right side of the hint row (e.g. 'claude-fable-5')

show_banner.label: Show the 'Welcome to Claude Code!' banner when there is no history (default true)

history.label: Pre-existing transcript blocks rendered at open: [{type: 'user'|'text'|'tool'|'todo', ...}] -- user/text take {text}; tool takes {tool, target, result, diff}; todo takes {items: [{text, done}]}.

prompt_text.label: SHORTHAND: the prompt to type and send (compiled to type-prompt + send-prompt + working when no script is given)

tool_calls.label: SHORTHAND: [{tool, target, result, diff?}] -- staggered tool-call actions across the scene when no script is given

response_text.label: SHORTHAND: Claude's final response, streamed word by word near the end

script.label: THE COMPONENT'S MAIN POWER -- the full session performance: [{"action": "...", "at": seconds, ...}]. Actions: type-prompt {text} (types into the input), send-prompt (posts the prompt to the transcript), working {text?, tokens_per_s?} (spinner with LIVE elapsed seconds + climbing token count; auto-removed by the next tool-call/respond), stop-working, tool-call {tool: 'Read'|'Bash'|'Update'|'Write'|'Grep', target: 'src/app.ts', result: 'Read 240 lines', diff?: ['+ added line', '- removed line', 'context'], then_working?: false} (⏺ block with ⎿ result; re-shows the spinner unless then_working:false), respond {text, duration?} (streams Claude's answer word by word; **bold** and `code` supported), todo {items: [{text, done}]} (checklist block), claude-text {text} (instant prose block). Plus base actions: move-cursor, click, wait, parallel. NEVER move the camera from a script -- use scene camera_moves with anchors (input, transcript).

script_actions.description: Type text into the input box character by character (border glows while active)
Post the typed prompt into the transcript as a user block and clear the input
Show the Claude Code working spinner: rotating ✳, verb, and a LIVE '(12s · ↑ 3.1k tokens · esc to interrupt)' counter that climbs with scene time
A tool-use block lands: '⏺ Tool(target)' with a '⎿ result' line and an optional green/red diff. Replaces the spinner, then re-shows it (set then_working:false to stop).

params.diff: array - ['+ new line', '- old line', 'context line'] painted green/red
params.then_working: boolean - keep the spinner going after (default true)

script_actions.description: Stream Claude's response word by word (**bold** and `code` render); removes the spinner
Show a todo checklist block (☐ pending / ☒ struck-through done)
